data.name: Hunters Origin
data.detailed_description:
Hunters Origin invites you to carve your own legend in the Northern Lands

Explore a living online world filled with dangerous hunts, hidden secrets, powerful loot, and a town worth coming home to in Hunters Origin. This action-packed RPG offers plenty of depth and complexity along with exciting combat and progression.

Follow the main story in the Northern Lands or shape your own path by taking on hundreds of side quests. Your choices can unlock new paths, restore forgotten places, and help shape Archer's Pond.

OK, but what is Archer’s Pond?

This is your main base, your quest hub, your place to go back to and rest. It’s also where you meet other players. Forge gear, trade resources, swap stories at the tavern, show off your mount, spend time with friends. Archer's Pond is a place to prepare for adventure and a place to return to when the hunt is over.

When you’re ready go out there and hunt!

With what though?

You first pick one of six starting classes that you are then free to evolve into something uniquely yours. Experiment with a deep skill tree, class evolution, powerful item sets, and more than 1,000 items. Fine-tune your stats, combine talents and gear, exploit elemental weaknesses, and adapt your build to every challenge.

And what are we fighting for?

For loot, obviously! After defeating your enemies, find powerful gear with unique bonuses and distinctive looks. Complete item sets, collect rare mounts, and ride into danger on everything from saber-toothed cats to massive war mammoths. After all, what's the point of legendary loot if nobody gets to see it?

Gather materials, craft equipment, brew potions, trade with others, and contribute to the growth of the world around you. Progress doesn't stop when combat ends - crafting and resource management are part of the journey.

Come join us now!

data.short_description: Oldshool MMORPG foundations, sprinkled with modern gameplay! Hunt dangerous beasts, claim legendary loot, and customize your build with deep skill trees. Develop your hub at Archer’s Pond, craft gear, collect rare mounts, and forge your own legend alongside other players!
